//: Type-checks the verifier and guard scripts. They are plain .mjs and the root tsconfig only includes .ts, so until 2026-11-25 nothing looked at them — and every QA verdict rests on them. Deliberately not strict: this catches wrong names, wrong arities and wrong shapes in 5,700 lines of untyped JavaScript without demanding annotations for all of it. Run with `npm run typecheck:tools`.
